name: Komame
source: Kunitaka’s sparrow. It’s originally a wild sparrow, but after Kunitaka helped it recover from injuries, the sparrow stays with him. Despite that, it seems to hate Kunitaka. Takes a liking to the heroine from their first meeting and begins following her around after that.
